entries.title: AP LT Tariff FY 2026-27 overview
entries.body: Tariff rates are from APERC Tariff Order FY 2026-27, Chapter XI, effective 25 March 2026. Ask about domestic, commercial, industry, agriculture, institutional, temporary supply, delayed payment surcharge (₹25), customer charges, reconnection, or meter testing. Use the Calculator page for bill estimates. This app is unofficial.
